description: STILLWATER, Minn. — On Tuesday, Nat Smith released the first ad of his 2026 campaign as the DFL candidate for Senate District 33. The ad, “Root Out,” highlights Smith’s role in a whistleblower claim that disrupted a Medicaid fraud scheme stealing from Minnesota taxpayers.

title: Nat Smith Pledges to Continue Fighting Fraud in First Digital Ad — Nat Smith for Minnesota
